_about: Public-domain Thomas C. Upham (Thomas Cogswell Upham, 1799-1872, Bowdoin College, holiness writer) for the Word Hoard: Principles of the Interior or Hidden Life (1843), Life of Madame Catharine Adorna (1845), Religious Maxims (1846), the Life of Madame Guyon, 2 vols. (1847), A Treatise on Divine Union (1851), The Life of Faith (1852), his analysis of Guyon's Method of Prayer (1859), Christ in the Soul (1872), Absolute Religion (1873) and Ratio Disciplinae (1829), raw Internet Archive OCR. His mental-philosophy textbooks are alternates. Quietist sympathies; veto point. Added 2026-10-10 by lane A, round 19 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. No uids minted.
